status: exploratory; frozen before any tuning; never loosened afterwards
purpose: Gate for a downrange powered landing of the vv-ascent booster, judged by a Python 2D point-mass reference before any Rust is written.

thresholds.source_of_speeds: docs/m9-powered-landing.md (R1 vertical speed, R2 horizontal speed <= 1.0 m/s); the radius is stated here because the downrange zone is new (M9 uses 10 m on a pad with a 0.05 m altimeter-class sensor)

landing_zone.rule: midpoint of the recovery_zone already declared in each case (small 850 to 1150 km, medium 650 to 900 km), surface distance from the launch site at sea level

pass_rule: a vehicle passes if all 10 held-out seeds 5010 to 5019 meet every threshold, with the configuration chosen on seeds 5000 to 5009 only; the held-out seeds are run once

inputs.states: scripts/data/m18_booster_gate_states.json: the true separation state, true mass, propellant and first-stage dispersion factors recorded from real vv-ascent runs (nominal cases as bundled in recovery/science fc24942, dispersions on, seeds 5000 to 5019)

assumptions.dynamics: planar point mass over the spherical non-rotating Earth of vv-ascent: inverse-square gravity, isothermal exponential atmosphere (1.225 kg/m3, 8500 m), drag with the stage Cd and area, thrust at fixed mass flow with Isp(p) between sea-level and vacuum, instantaneous thrust direction, no attitude dynamics
assumptions.true_vehicle: first stage with the recorded dispersion factors (thrust, Isp, dry mass); the booster mass and propellant at separation are the recorded true values
assumptions.guidance_knowledge: nominal vehicle of the case and a propellant estimate equal to the nominal reserve (reserve_fraction times the first-stage load): never the true state, true vehicle or true propellant

navigation.noise: white, Gaussian, from random.Random with an explicit seed per run, at every control tick

optional_landing_altimeter.note: a declared exploratory case parameter; with none the radial position of the navigation solution is used

engines.model: the stage thrust and mass flow split equally over n engines; the guidance lights k of them at a throttle between the stage throttle_min and throttle_max; the throttle floor is not lowered

assumptions.integration: RK4 at 0.02 s while an engine is lit or below 60 km altitude, 0.5 s otherwise; the guidance runs at 50 Hz; contact is the interpolated crossing of zero altitude

may_change: engine count among the allowed values
